must.title: Security of Retry Mechanisms
must.description: Ensure retry mechanisms do not introduce security vulnerabilities.
must.metric: No security vulnerabilities related to retry logic.
acceptance_criteria: Security tests cover all retry scenarios.
No sensitive information is exposed during retries.
Retry logic adheres to security best practices.

must.title: Reliability of Retry Mechanisms
must.description: Ensure retry mechanisms are reliable and consistent.
must.metric: Retry success rate of 99.9% under normal conditions.
acceptance_criteria: Reliability tests confirm retry success rates.
No data loss occurs during retries.
must.verification: Reliability test with controlled failure injection.

should.title: System Performance Under Load
should.description: Ensure the system performs efficiently under load with retry mechanisms in place.
should.metric: System maintains a response time of <500ms under peak load.
acceptance_criteria: Performance tests simulate peak load conditions.
System response times are within acceptable limits.
Retry logic does not degrade system performance.
should.verification: Load test at 10× expected peak; measure p95/p99.

should.title: Scalability of Retry Logic
should.description: Ensure retry logic scales with increasing system demand.
should.metric: Retry logic scales to support 10,000 concurrent users.
acceptance_criteria: Scalability tests validate retry logic under high concurrency.
System resources are efficiently utilized during retries.
No bottlenecks are introduced by retry mechanisms.
should.verification: Scalability test with concurrent user simulation.

should.title: Usability of Retry Configuration
should.description: Ensure retry configuration is user-friendly and accessible.
should.metric: User satisfaction score of 90% for retry configuration interface.
acceptance_criteria: User feedback confirms ease of configuration.
Documentation supports user understanding of retry settings.
Configuration changes are reflected immediately in the system.
should.verification: Usability testing with user feedback sessions.
